visualCharacteristics.description: Dark Chevron blue (#0c2e72) full-width band, white centered heading, 4 white pill buttons with navy text in a 4-column row.

contentPattern.description: One row of N cells (4 on source), one link per cell rendered as a pill button. Pair with section style 'blue-bg' and a default-content heading above. A cell with no link renders as plain left-aligned text (text + button band, e.g. on sky-blue-bg). An image before the link text in a cell renders as an icon (social rows). Option links: underlined inline text links instead of pills (jump links, filter links). Option red: red (#b5121b) square buttons with white labels (Havoline gf-7 jump links). Option icons: icon-only social links (78px icons, label visually hidden as the accessible name).
contentPattern.structure: 1 row x N cells, each a single link (optional icon image) or plain text
